1. 20 audit inspectors to be trained 2. A communication strategy to be formulated for inclusive, gender sensitive and transparent fiscal management 3. At least 10,000 citizens to be reached by activities included within the communication strategy, whose at least 50% are women 4. A transparency portal to be developed and freely accessible to all citizens 5. An integrated data management system to be adopted and operational to improve effectiveness and transparency of the IGF 6. A water facility built to generate cohesion through women-led water sharing and management between Afar and Somali communities 7. 1 acre covered by the joint farm 8. 45 to 55% of Afar farmers using joint farming facilities 9. 45 to 55% of Somali farmers using joint farming facilities 10. 50 women actively engaged and leading the resources management process 11. 60 persons actively participating in organized activities generating social cohesion (whose 55% are women) 12. 10,000 persons reached through organized activities generating social cohesion (whose 55% are women) 13. 45 young men and 55 young women whose capacities have been enforced for peace promotion and social cohesion enforcement 14. 120 women whose digital capacities shall be developed to play a key role as peace promoters and neutralize hate speech
